source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of time complexity (PDF 78).

blocks.text: Time complexity is baat ka measure (naap) hai ke input data ka size barhne par algorithm ka runtime (chalne ka waqt) kaise barhta hai. Is se samajh aata hai ke zyada data hone par algorithm kitni efficiency se kaam karta hai.

Misal: numbers ki list sort karne ka kaam lein. List mein thore numbers hon to kaam jaldi ho jata hai. Lekin numbers ki ginti barhne par sort karne ka waqt bhi barhta hai. Time complexity se hum andaza laga sakte hain ke list bari hone par yeh runtime kis tarah barhega.

blocks.prompt: Time complexity ki behtareen definition kya hai (MCQ 9)?
blocks.explanation: (b) Algorithm ke mukammal hone ka waqt, input size ke function ke taur par.

items: Time complexity: input size barhne par runtime kaise barhta hai.
